title: Large language models are unstable as autonomous medical evaluators across clinical tasks.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 大模型作自主医学评判者跨任务不稳定
summary: JAMIA 研究以 10 个 LLM 在 3 个临床任务上做自动评判、共 25,680 次判定，发现评判性能跨任务不稳定。
key_points: 10 个模型含 Claude、GPT、DeepSeek，温度 0 各评 3 次
任务为 LiveQA-Med、PubMedQA 与 MIMIC 分诊
无模型在各任务排名一致，难以跨任务沿用
reason: 同行评审，三个任务含独立数据集、2.5 万次判定，属重要档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated evaluators of medical text ("LLM-as-judge"). We tested whether LLM-evaluator performance validated on one medical task against a human reference standard remains stable on a structurally different task. We evaluated 10 LLMs (3 locally served open-source and 7 API models: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek) as autonomous judges on 3 tasks with human reference labels: LiveQA-Med answer quality (n = 300), PubMedQA research appraisal (n = 300), and Emergency Severity Index (ESI) triage on MIMIC-IV-Ext (n = 256). Each case was scored 3 times per model at temperature zero (25 680 judgments). Analyses used cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals, quadratic-weighted Cohen's κ, and false-discovery-rate correction. Evaluator performance was unstable across tasks: no model ranked in the top 3 on all 3 tasks, and every model shifted by 3 or more rank positions between at least one pair of tasks. In the highest-stakes task, ESI level 1 (Resuscitation) cases were under-triaged in 89.1% of evaluations, in all 10 models (range 70.2%-96.9%). Best triage agreement only reached the human inter-rater range (Claude Opus quadratic-weighted κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]). Locally served 7-27B models (no per-query charge) occupied the Pareto frontier on the text tasks but only its low-concordance end on triage. LLM-evaluator performance is unstable between medical tasks that differ in cognitive structure; performance validated on one task should not be assumed to transfer to another. Task-specific validation against human reference labels is required before deployment, and emergency triage demands human oversight at the highest-acuity tier.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被用作医学文本的自动评估器（“LLM-as-judge”）。我们检验了：在某一医学任务上以人类参考标准验证的 LLM 评估器表现，在结构不同的任务上是否仍保持稳定。我们将 10 个 LLM（3 个本地部署的开源模型和 7 个 API 模型：Claude、GPT、DeepSeek）作为自主评判者，在 3 个具有人类参考标签的任务上进行评估：LiveQA-Med 答案质量（n = 300）、PubMedQA 研究评价（n = 300），以及 MIMIC-IV-Ext 上的急诊严重指数（ESI）分诊（n = 256）。每个病例在每个模型上以温度零重复评分 3 次（共 25 680 次判断）。分析使用聚类自助法置信区间、二次加权 Cohen's κ 和错误发现率校正。评估器表现跨任务不稳定：没有任何模型在全部 3 个任务上都排名前 3，且每个模型在至少一对任务之间排名移动 3 个或更多位次。在风险最高的任务中，ESI 1 级（复苏）病例在 89.1% 的评估中被分诊不足，且见于全部 10 个模型（范围 70.2%-96.9%）。最佳分诊一致性仅达到人类评分者间范围（Claude Opus 二次加权 κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]）。本地部署的 7-27B 模型（无按查询计费）在文本任务上占据帕累托前沿，但在分诊上仅处于其低一致性端。LLM 评估器表现会在认知结构不同的医学任务之间不稳定；在一个任务上验证的表现不应假定可迁移到另一个任务。部署前需要针对具体任务使用人类参考标签进行验证，而急诊分诊在最高急症层级需要人类监督。

title: Silent Manipulation of Mental Health Treatment Recommendations From a Large Language Model.
zh_title: 大模型心理健康治疗推荐可被静默操纵
summary: 研究显示，对开源大模型施加激活引导，可在不改权重、不改提示词且不告知用户的情况下改变其抑郁症治疗推荐。
key_points: 12个抑郁咨询情境，30档引导强度
激活引导不改变权重与提示词
推荐可被商业或意识形态目的静默改变
reason: JAMA Netw Open同行评审，安全问题新颖，但仅12个情境的小规模非人研究，属值得一看档
abstract: Importance: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly inform mental health decisions by patients and clinicians. Inference-time activation steering can shift model behavior on a target dimension without altering weights or prompts and without disclosure to users, allowing treatment recommendations to be silently changed for commercial or ideological reasons. Objective: To determine whether directional activation steering can shift an open-weights LLM's depression treatment recommendations. Design Setting and Participants: This non-human subjects study applied directional activation steering to an open-weights LLM (DeepSeek V4 Flash) responding to 12 depression-advice scenarios (4 favoring medication, 4 favoring avoidance, 4 neutral), generated at 30 amplitudes from -1.5 to +1.5 in 0.1 increments plus an unsteered baseline. Exposures: A single steering direction contrasting antidepressant medication with self-directed approaches (diet, exercise, meditation, dietary supplements), constructed from 16 paired training prompts and applied at the attention output of every transformer block; weights and system prompt were held constant. Main Outcomes and Measures: The extent to which medication and four self-care categories were addressed, scored 0 to 3 by a human-validated LLM rater (Claude Opus 4.7), the medication-versus-self-care balance, and clinician referral, estimated per unit of amplitude using mixed-effects models with a scenario random intercept. Results: Across 372 generations, steering produced a graded, dose-dependent shift in the medication-versus-self-care balance, which declined by 0.32 per unit of amplitude (β = -0.32; 95% CI, -0.39 to -0.25; P < .001); medication extent fell and self-care extent rose. The shift was largest for scenarios with no stated treatment preference (β = -0.44; 95% CI, -0.54 to -0.34; P < .001). A clinician referral appeared in 322 of 372 responses (87%) and did not vary with steering amplitude (P = .63). Conclusions and Relevance: In this open-weights LLM providing depression treatment information, inference-time activation steering shifted treatment recommendations without altering weights, prompt structure, or safety outputs, with the largest effect among users expressing no treatment preference. These findings suggest a need for LLM disclosure standards and independent auditing as such models inform clinical decisions.
zh_abstract: 【重要性】大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地影响患者和临床医生做出的心理健康决策。推理时激活引导（inference-time activation steering）能够在既不改变权重也不改变提示、且不向用户披露的情况下，使模型行为在某一目标维度上发生偏移，从而可能出于商业或意识形态原因被悄然改变治疗建议。【目的】确定方向性激活引导是否能改变一个开放权重LLM的抑郁症治疗建议。【设计、场景与参与者】这项非人类受试者研究将方向性激活引导应用于一个开放权重LLM（DeepSeek V4 Flash），使其对12个抑郁症建议情景（4个倾向药物治疗、4个倾向回避、4个中性）作出回应；这些情景在-1.5至+1.5范围内以0.1为增量生成30个幅度，另加一个未引导的基线。【暴露】一个单一的引导方向，用于对比抗抑郁药物治疗与自我主导方法（饮食、运动、冥想、膳食补充剂），由16对配对训练提示构建，并施加于每个transformer模块的注意力输出；权重和系统提示保持不变。【主要结局与指标】药物治疗和四个自我照护类别被涉及的程度（由经人工验证的LLM评分者（Claude Opus 4.7）按0至3分评分）、药物治疗与自我照护的平衡以及临床医生转诊，均使用以情景为随机截距的混合效应模型按每单位幅度估计。【结果】在372次生成中，引导在药物治疗与自我照护的平衡上产生了分级、剂量依赖性的偏移，每单位幅度下降0.32（β = -0.32；95% CI，-0.39至-0.25；P < .001）；药物治疗程度下降，自我照护程度上升。该偏移在未陈述治疗偏好的情景中最大（β = -0.44；95% CI，-0.54至-0.34；P < .001）。372条回应中有322条（87%）出现临床医生转诊，且不随引导幅度变化（P = .63）。【结论与意义】在这个提供抑郁症治疗信息的开放权重LLM中，推理时激活引导在不改变权重、提示结构或安全输出的情况下改变了治疗建议，其效应在未表达治疗偏好的使用者中最大。这些发现提示，随着此类模型影响临床决策，有必要制定LLM披露标准并开展独立审计。

title: Artificial intelligence in dialysis.
source: PubMed · Current opinion in nephrology and hypertension
zh_title: 透析中的AI：从算法开发走向临床实施与治理
summary: 综述指出透析 AI 已进入实施与治理阶段，涉及首项随机试验、21 项 RCT 的 meta 分析及学会框架。
key_points: 首项 AI 指导透析剂量随机试验已发表

reason: 综述类最高 6 分；涵盖随机试验与 meta 分析及治理框架，信息密度较高
abstract: [Current opinion in nephrology and hypertension] Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning in dialysis have matured beyond the initial phase of algorithm development. Recent work has shifted toward clinical implementation, evaluation, and governance. During the past year, the first randomized trial of AI-guided dosing in maintenance hemodialysis has been published, a meta-analysis of technology-guided dry-weight adjustment has appeared, and the first professional society framework for the responsible use of AI in kidney care has been released. The Anemia Control Model is now supported by hospitalization outcomes and cost-effectiveness analyses. A randomized trial demonstrated that AI-guided erythropoiesis-stimulating agent dosing achieved outcomes comparable to physician-directed dosing. Technology-guided dry-weight adjustment is supported by a meta-analysis of 21 randomized trials. Machine learning for vascular access is evolving toward preoperative clinical decision support, while peritoneal dialysis is beginning to receive greater attention from the machine learning community. Large language models are entering nephrology along two complementary paths: open generative systems for education and clinical support, and deterministic, protocol-driven frameworks designed for safety-critical bedside applications. At the same time, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has released comprehensive lifecycle guidance for AI-enabled medical devices. The major challenge for AI in dialysis is no longer developing accurate prediction models. Instead, success will depend on effective workflow integration, validation across diverse patient populations, ongoing postdeployment monitoring, and demonstrating meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Current Opinion in Nephrology and Hypertension] 透析中的人工智能（AI）和机器学习已超越算法开发的初始阶段。近期工作已转向临床实施、评估和治理。在过去一年中，首项关于维持性血液透析中 AI 指导给药的随机试验已发表，一项关于技术引导的干体重调整的荟萃分析已出现，并且首个关于在肾脏照护中负责任使用 AI 的专业学会框架已发布。贫血控制模型（Anemia Control Model）现已得到住院结局和成本效果分析的支持。一项随机试验表明，AI 指导的促红细胞生成素刺激剂给药取得了与医生指导给药相当的结果。技术引导的干体重调整得到一项纳入 21 项随机试验的荟萃分析支持。用于血管通路的机器学习正朝着术前临床决策支持方向发展，而腹膜透析正开始受到机器学习界更多关注。大语言模型正沿两条互补路径进入肾脏病学：用于教育和临床支持的开放式生成系统，以及为安全关键的床旁应用设计的确定性、方案驱动框架。与此同时，美国食品药品监督管理局（U.S. Food and Drug Administration）已发布针对 AI 赋能医疗器械的全面全生命周期指南。透析中 AI 的主要挑战不再是开发准确的预测模型。相反，成功将取决于有效的工作流程整合、在不同患者人群中的验证、持续的部署后监测，以及证明患者结局有意义的改善。

title: Applying artificial intelligence to optical coherence tomography for detection and subtyping of basal cell carcinoma.
source: PubMed · Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG

abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common cancer and a major public health burden. Noninvasive techniques such as optical coherence tomography (OCT) may reduce unnecessary biopsies and enable earlier detection. However, effective OCT interpretation requires expertise. Artificial intelligence (AI) may help overcome this barrier. An AI model based on a U-Net convolutional neural network was trained using 4,680 annotated OCT image frames from 39 BCCs, 5,640 frames from 47 premalignant and benign lesions, and 12,360 frames from 103 scans of healthy skin. Detection performance was evaluated on an independent test set comprising 26 scans (3,120 frames) from 16 BCCs, 5 premalignant lesions, and 5 benign lesions. External validation used independent clinical data from 25 histologically confirmed BCCs (18 nodular, 7 superficial). AI-assisted OCT generated visual overlays corresponding to established BCC features and identified tumor areas. In the independent test set, the area under the ROC curve was 95.5 % for nodular and 98.2 % for superficial BCC. In clinical validation, all BCCs were detected, and subtype concordance with histology was achieved in 21 of 25 cases (83 %). AI-assisted OCT shows potential to improve non-invasive BCC diagnostics and warrants further clinical evaluation.
zh_abstract: [Journal der Deutschen Dermatologischen Gesellschaft = Journal of the German Society of Dermatology : JDDG] 基底细胞癌（BCC）是最常见的癌症，也是重大的公共卫生负担。光学相干断层扫描（OCT）等无创技术可减少不必要的活检并实现更早发现。然而，有效的OCT判读需要专业知识。人工智能（AI）可能有助于克服这一障碍。基于U-Net卷积神经网络的AI模型使用来自39例BCC的4,680个标注OCT图像帧、来自47个癌前病变和良性病变的5,640个帧，以及来自103次健康皮肤扫描的12,360个帧进行训练。检测性能在独立测试集上评估，该测试集包括来自16例BCC、5个癌前病变和5个良性病变的26次扫描（3,120个帧）。外部验证使用来自25例经组织学确诊的BCC（18例结节型，7例浅表型）的独立临床数据。AI辅助OCT生成了与既定BCC特征相对应的视觉叠加图，并识别了肿瘤区域。在独立测试集中，结节型BCC的ROC曲线下面积为95.5%，浅表型BCC为98.2%。在临床验证中，所有BCC均被检出，25例中有21例（83%）实现了与组织学的亚型一致性。AI辅助OCT显示出改善无创BCC诊断的潜力，值得进一步临床评估。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Southern California; conditions: Glaucoma; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1386; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This randomized controlled trial will compare an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted teleglaucoma referral pathway with conventional referral among adults identified with referable glaucoma through the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services (LAC DHS) Teleretinal Screening Program. The primary objective is to determine whether AI-assisted referral reduces time to in-office diagnosis of manifest glaucoma. Secondary outcomes include glaucoma severity, visual function, need for glaucoma surgery, patient-reported quality of life and satisfaction, health system resource utilization, and cost-effectiveness.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：南加州大学；疾病：青光眼；类型：干预性；阶段：不适用；入组人数：1386；状态：尚未招募] 这项随机对照试验将在通过洛杉矶县卫生服务局（LAC DHS）远程视网膜筛查项目被识别为患有需转诊青光眼的成人中，比较人工智能（AI）辅助的远程青光眼转诊路径与常规转诊。主要目的是确定AI辅助转诊是否缩短了诊室内确诊显性青光眼的时间。次要结局包括青光眼严重程度、视觉功能、青光眼手术需求、患者报告的生活质量和满意度、卫生系统资源利用以及成本效果。

title: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
zh_title: MedGraph：用图记忆维护长期医疗对话中的患者状态
summary: 预印本提出面向长期医疗对话的图记忆系统，按时间抽取事实、归属到具体患者并链接成链，以改善检索准确性。
key_points: 归纳五种记忆系统的三类错误：状态过时、他人事实混入、缺安全事实
构建时抽取带日期事实并归属到对应个人，药物诊断测量成链保留历史状态
检索按患者事实链为单位、按问题所问时间点读取，并附原文对话
reason: 预印本新方法，与五个基线记忆系统对比并自建基准，但无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
zh_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的医疗助手在跨就诊随访患者时，需要一种能在患者临床状态变化时保持其正确的记忆。我们考察了五种记忆系统在纵向医学对话中的错误，发现三类反复出现的原因：检索到的证据给出过时状态、包含他人的健康事实，或缺少答案所依赖的安全性事实。我们提出MedGraph，一种针对这三种情况构建的图记忆。构建过程从每次会话中提取带日期的事实，将每条事实归属于其所描述的人，并将药物、诊断和测量记录链接成保留早期状态的链。检索以患者为单元对其链进行排序，在问题所询问的时间点读取每条链，并加入原始对话文本；患者档案列出每条记录的安全性事实与每个问题。在MedMemoryBench上，MedGraph在GPT和Qwen骨干模型下均具有最高总体准确率，分别比五个基线中最强者高10.5和10.4分，并在GPT设置下具有高效的内存构建和回答。

title: A decision-only model as a low-cost judge of medical AI answers
zh_title: 仅决策模型可作为医疗 AI 答案的低成本评判者
summary: medRxiv 预印本：在五项临床基准上预注册评估，比较仅输出结构化概率的轻量决策模型与大模型评判者的表现。
key_points: 覆盖五个已验证临床基准任务
与专家评分者及多个大模型评判者对照
提出决策模型与廉价 LLM 的混合方案
reason: 预注册、多基准对照的评测方法预印本，尚无外部临床验证
abstract: BackgroundTesting and deploying medical AI systems at scale already results in more outputs than clinicians can review, and the use of large language models (LLMs) as judges is growing rapidly. Decision-only models, cheap and fast models that return structured probabilities rather than text, offer a potentially scalable option for that goal. MethodsIn an OSF pre-registered evaluation, we tested TypeSafe Jev 1.13 as a judge on tasks from five validated clinical benchmarks: rubric grading (HealthBench), planted clinical errors (When Rubrics Fail), risk in AI-written clinical documents (MedVAL), counseling ratings and failures (CounselBench) and physicians preferences between answers (Real-POCQi). Comparators were expert raters agreement with each other, OpenAI Decisions, GPT-6 Luna, a proposed hybrid team combining decision models and a cheap LLM and, as frontier comparators, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. The main outcome was plain agreement with the expert label. ResultsThe test comprised 25,091 units and 213,913 model calls. Jevs agreement with expert labels averaged 64.7% over six tasks. On 3,614 matched units it averaged 66.1%, against 65.0% for Opus and 60.7% for Sol, and it was non-inferior to both on four of six tasks. Jev judged the whole pool in 17 minutes for US$1.46; per judgment, it cost 1/34 of Sols price and 1/152 of Opuss. A preset cutoff held its false-alarm rate on fresh planted-error answers, and in simulation, reviewing Jevs least-sure answers first found 1.4 times the errors of a random audit. Still, omissions were hard for both: at the same false-alarm rate, Jev missed 55.6% of planted omissions and Opus 48.1%, and Opus caught 8.8 points more planted errors overall. ConclusionsAcross more than 200,000 model calls, a decision-only model was non-inferior to two frontier judges on most tasks at a small fraction of their cost and time, while reporting how sure it was of every call. With local cutoffs and expert oversight of omissions and clinical documents, judging every output of a deployed medical AI system becomes more affordable.
zh_abstract:
【背景】大规模测试和部署医疗 AI 系统已经产生超出临床医生可审阅数量的输出，而使用大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的做法正在迅速增长。仅决策模型（decision-only models）——即返回结构化概率而非文本的廉价、快速模型——为这一目标提供了一种潜在可扩展的选择。
【方法】在一项 OSF 预注册评估中，我们将 TypeSafe Jev 1.13 作为评判者，在来自五个经过验证的临床基准的任务上进行测试：评分细则评分（HealthBench）、植入临床错误（When Rubrics Fail）、AI 撰写的临床文件中的风险（MedVAL）、咨询评分与失败（CounselBench）以及医生对答案的偏好（Real-POCQi）。对照包括专家评分者彼此之间的一致性、OpenAI Decisions、GPT-6 Luna、一个将决策模型与廉价 LLM 结合的拟议混合团队，以及作为前沿对照的 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5。主要结局是与专家标签的简单一致率。
【结果】测试包含 25,091 个单元和 213,913 次模型调用。Jev 与专家标签的一致率在六项任务上平均为 64.7%。在 3,614 个匹配单元上，其平均一致率为 66.1%，而 Opus 为 65.0%，Sol 为 60.7%，并且它在六项任务中的四项上不劣于两者。Jev 在 17 分钟内以 1.46 美元评判了整个池；按单次判断计，其成本为 Sol 价格的 1/34、Opus 价格的 1/152。一个预设截断值在新鲜的植入错误答案上保持了其假警报率，并且在模拟中，优先审阅 Jev 最不确定的答案所发现的错误是随机审计的 1.4 倍。尽管如此，遗漏对两者都很难：在相同假警报率下，Jev 漏掉了 55.6% 的植入遗漏，Opus 漏掉了 48.1%，而 Opus 总体上多发现了 8.8 个百分点的植入错误。
【结论】在超过 200,000 次模型调用中，仅决策模型在大多数任务上不劣于两个前沿评判模型，而成本和时间仅为其一小部分，同时报告其对每次调用的确定程度。借助本地截断值以及对遗漏和临床文件的专家监督，对已部署医疗 AI 系统的每一条输出进行评判变得更加可负担。

title: Multi-center Prospective Validation of Real-Time AI-EGGIM System
zh_title: 实时 AI-EGGIM 系统的多中心前瞻性验证
summary: 山东大学齐鲁医院注册的多中心前瞻性观察研究，计划入组 540 例，验证实时 AI 辅助 EGGIM 评分系统，尚无结果。
key_points: 多中心前瞻性观察设计，计划入组 540 例
AI 实时判读五个胃区并计算 EGGIM 总分
针对胃癌前病变胃肠上皮化生，尚未开始招募
reason: 前瞻性多中心设计加分，但仅为试验注册、无结果数据
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Qilu Hospital of Shandong University; conditions: Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 540; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Gastric intestinal metaplasia (GIM) is a precancerous condition associated with an increased risk of gastric cancer. The endoscopic grading of gastric intestinal metaplasia (EGGIM) score evaluates the extent of GIM across five standard gastric regions. The investigators developed a real-time artificial intelligence-assisted EGGIM (AI-EGGIM) system that automatically assigns an intestinal metaplasia grade to each region and calculates a total EGGIM score. This prospective multi-center validation study will consecutively enroll patients undergoing upper gastrointestinal endoscopy. The AI-EGGIM system will generate real-time grades for the five standard gastric regions. Regardless of endoscopic appearance or AI output, every patient will undergo five mapping biopsies, with one biopsy obtained from each standard region. Histopathological operative link on gastric intestinal metaplasia (OLGIM) staging will serve as the reference standard. The primary objective is to estimate the performance of an AI-EGGIM score ≥ 5 for identifying patients at high risk of gastric cancer.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：山东大学齐鲁医院；疾病：胃黏膜肠化生；类型：观察性；入组人数：540；状态：尚未招募] 胃黏膜肠化生（gastric intestinal metaplasia, GIM）是一种癌前病变，与胃癌风险增加相关。胃黏膜肠化生内镜分级（endoscopic grading of gastric intestinal metaplasia, EGGIM）评分评估 GIM 在五个标准胃区域的范围。研究者开发了一种实时人工智能辅助 EGGIM（AI-EGGIM）系统，可自动为每个区域分配肠化生分级并计算总 EGGIM 评分。这项前瞻性多中心验证研究将连续入组接受上消化道内镜检查的患者。AI-EGGIM 系统将实时生成五个标准胃区域的分级。无论内镜表现或 AI 输出如何，每位患者都将接受五点定位活检，每个标准区域取一块活检。组织病理学 OLGIM（operative link on gastric intestinal metaplasia）分期将作为参考标准。主要目标是评估 AI-EGGIM 评分 ≥ 5 用于识别胃癌高风险患者的性能。

title: Hierarchical Temporal Transformer for Cancer Grade Prediction and Cross-Cancer Transfer Learning from Pathology Reports
zh_title: 分层时序Transformer从病理报告预测肿瘤分级并跨癌种迁移
summary: 预印本提出分层时序Transformer，用改编BiomedBERT编码病理报告并结合就诊间隔，在合成基准与4786份TCGA报告上做分级预测与跨癌种迁移。
key_points: 模型结合报告文本与就诊间隔的时间编码
两个合成基准各用十个随机种子评估
TCGA 14个癌种中保留3种做跨癌种测试
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，仅内部/留出癌种验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Language models for cancer reports usually read one document at a time and are tested on tumour types seen in training. Continuous-time sequence models address the first gap, but whether they use visit timing, not just order, is seldom tested. Methods: We developed the Hierarchical Temporal Transformer (HTT), which encodes reports with adapted BiomedBERT and reads the sequence with a cancer-type-conditioned temporal transformer. We evaluated it against best-possible AUROC ceilings on two synthetic benchmarks, one with the label stated in the text and one recoverable only from tumour sizes and visit intervals (ten seeds). Diagnostics led to an interval-aware time code (HTT-IA). On 4,786 TCGA pathology reports in 14 types, three types were withheld, and a text-only HTT was compared with a survival model. Results: On the phrase benchmark HTT reached AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012 against 0.913 +/- 0.007 for a last-report baseline (+0.018, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.050); dates cannot raise the ceiling there. On the growth benchmark the initial time code scored 0.790, equal to a no-time model (0.787), whereas HTT-IA reached 0.843 (+0.053, 0.026 to 0.082) against ceilings of 0.894 without and 0.979 with dates. On unseen tumour types HTT reached 0.925 +/- 0.007, equal to in-distribution performance and to a single-report baseline. Text-only macro C-index was 0.592 (CALM 0.626-0.652). Conclusion: Cross-type transfer is carried by the pre-trained encoder. Visit timing is used only when the data make it identifiable and the time code is on a clinical scale. Ceilings, order-only ablations and re-dating probes are inexpensive checks for such models.
zh_abstract:
【背景】用于癌症报告的语言模型通常一次阅读一份文件，并在训练中见过的肿瘤类型上进行测试。连续时间序列模型解决了第一个缺口，但其是否使用就诊时间而不仅仅是顺序，鲜有检验。
【方法】我们开发了分层时间 Transformer（Hierarchical Temporal Transformer, HTT），其使用适配的 BiomedBERT 编码报告，并使用以癌症类型为条件的时间 transformer 读取序列。我们在两个合成基准上将其与最佳可能 AUROC 上限进行比较，一个基准的标签在文本中明确陈述，另一个只能从肿瘤大小和就诊间隔中恢复（十个随机种子）。诊断分析促成了一种间隔感知时间编码（HTT-IA）。在 14 种类型的 4,786 份 TCGA 病理报告中，三种类型被留出，并将仅文本 HTT 与生存模型进行比较。
【结果】在短语基准上，HTT 达到 AUROC 0.931 +/- 0.012，而最后报告基线为 0.913 +/- 0.007（+0.018，95% CI -0.009 至 +0.050）；在该基准中日期无法提高上限。在生长基准上，初始时间编码得分为 0.790，与无时间模型（0.787）相同，而 HTT-IA 达到 0.843（+0.053，0.026 至 0.082），对应上限为无日期时 0.894、有日期时 0.979。在未见肿瘤类型上，HTT 达到 0.925 +/- 0.007，与分布内性能以及单报告基线相同。仅文本的宏 C 指数为 0.592（CALM 0.626-0.652）。
【结论】跨类型迁移由预训练编码器承载。仅当数据使就诊时间可识别且时间编码处于临床尺度时，才会使用就诊时间。上限、仅顺序消融和重新标注日期探针是此类模型的低成本检查。

title: Predicting Extubation Failure Using Machine Learning
zh_title: 机器学习预测拔管失败：1065 例注册研究
summary: 印尼大学注册观察性研究，拟纳入 1065 例 ICU 成人，用机器学习预测拔管后 7 天内失败；目前尚无结果。
key_points: 来源为 ClinicalTrials.gov 注册，状态招募中
主要结局为再插管、气管切开或死亡

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Universitas Indonesia; conditions: Extubation Failure, Critical Illness; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1065; status: RECRUITING] The goal of this observational study is to predict who will have problems after the breathing tube is removed. Taking out the tube is called extubation, and having these problems is called extubation failure. Participants are adults in the intensive care unit (ICU) who use a breathing machine (ventilator). The main questions it aims to answer are: * How well can computer tools predict problems in the 7 days after the tube is removed? * Which information, such as age or blood tests, matters most for the prediction? Extubation failure means the participant needs the tube put back in, needs a surgical opening in the neck to help breathing, or dies. Researchers will use machine learning to build the computer tools. Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that finds patterns in data. Researchers will compare five types of machine learning to see which works best. They will build the tools with participants from Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo National General Hospital in Jakarta. They will test the tools with participants from Universitas Indonesia Hospital in Depok. Participants get their usual care. Doctors do not use the tools to make treatment decisions. Researchers will: * Record health information about participants before the tube is removed * Follow participants for 7 days after the tube is removed
zh_abstract:
[新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：印度尼西亚大学；疾病/状况：拔管失败、危重症；类型：观察性；入组人数：1065；状态：招募中] 这项观察性研究的目标是预测谁在呼吸管拔除后会出现问题。拔除管子称为拔管，出现这些问题称为拔管失败。参与者是重症监护病房（ICU）中使用呼吸机（ventilator）的成人。它旨在回答的主要问题是：
* 计算机工具能在多大程度上预测拔管后 7 天内的问题？
* 哪些信息（例如年龄或血液检查）对预测最重要？
拔管失败意味着参与者需要重新插管、需要颈部手术开口以帮助呼吸，或死亡。研究人员将使用机器学习来构建这些计算机工具。机器学习是一种在数据中寻找模式的人工智能。研究人员将比较五种机器学习，以确定哪种效果最好。他们将使用雅加达 Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo 国家综合医院的参与者来构建这些工具。他们将使用德波（Depok）印度尼西亚大学医院的参与者来测试这些工具。参与者接受常规护理。医生不会使用这些工具做出治疗决策。研究人员将：
* 在拔管前记录参与者的健康信息
* 在拔管后对参与者随访 7 天

title: Prototyping OSA: A New Framework for Predicting Cardiovascular Outcomes and CPAP Benefit
zh_title: OSA原型分型：预测心血管结局与CPAP获益
summary: 基于SAVE试验2676例数据的二次分析，用多域机器学习划分5种OSA原型并估计各原型的心血管风险与CPAP效应。
key_points: SAVE试验数据二次分析，2676名受试者、88个基线变量
高斯混合模型结合BIC与C-index选出五种原型，Cox模型估计MACE风险
用因果生存森林估计各原型的CPAP心血管效应，并比较生活质量与嗜睡量表
reason: 基于RCT数据的二次分析、样本可观，但为回顾性再分析且无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: RationaleObstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is associated with major adverse cardiac events (MACE); continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) has not reduced MACE in randomized trials. We hypothesized that multidomain machine learning would identify OSA subgroups differing in cardiovascular risk and CPAP response. MethodsWe conducted a secondary analysis of SAVE trial data. After preprocessing, Gaussian mixture models were fitted; Bayesian information criterion and C-index selected five prototypes. Cox models estimated MACE risk by prototype. Baseline quality of life (EQoL), Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS), and Framingham Risk Score (FRS) were compared; an existing causal survival forest model estimated prototype-specific CPAP effects on cardiovascular risk. Measurements and Main ResultsAfter preprocessing, five OSA prototypes were identified among 2,676 participants using 88 baseline variables. Prototypes differed in selected demographic, cardiometabolic, medication, and sleep variables, including smoking status, diabetes, prior myocardial infarction/stroke, antiplatelet/lipid-lowering therapy, BMI, oxygenation metrics, apnea-hypopnea index, and ESS (overall p<0.001). They also differed in baseline EQoL, FRS, MACE rate, and predicted CPAP response. Prototype 1 had the highest ESS, FRS, and MACE rate, whereas Prototype 5 had the lowest FRS and MACE rate. Using the causal survival forest model to assess prototype-specific CPAP effects on cardiovascular risk, Prototype 5 was predicted to benefit from CPAP (p<0.05), whereas Prototypes 1, 3, and 4 showed no benefit or possible harm. ConclusionThese findings demonstrate heterogeneity in cardiovascular risk and predicted CPAP response, potentially explaining neutral trial results. After external validation, these prototypes could guide trial enrichment and targeted CPAP use to improve cardiovascular outcomes. Impact StatementThis study advances clinical medicine by identifying multidomain OSA prototypes that differ in baseline cardiovascular risk and predicted cardiovascular response to CPAP, potentially supporting more precise treatment selection and future cardiovascular-outcomes trials. It adds to the disease knowledge base by showing that OSA-related cardiovascular risk is not captured by conventional severity metrics alone, but reflects interactions among sleep, cardiometabolic, demographic, and clinical characteristics. These findings provide a framework for mechanistic and prospective studies of the biological
zh_abstract: 【背景】阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）与主要不良心脏事件（MACE）相关；随机试验中持续气道正压通气（CPAP）并未减少MACE。我们假设多域机器学习可识别心血管风险和CPAP反应不同的OSA亚组。【方法】我们对SAVE试验数据进行了二次分析。预处理后拟合高斯混合模型；贝叶斯信息准则和C指数选择了五个原型。Cox模型估计各原型的MACE风险。比较基线生活质量（EQoL）、Epworth嗜睡量表（ESS）和Framingham风险评分（FRS）；使用现有的因果生存森林模型估计原型特异性CPAP对心血管风险的影响。【结果】预处理后，使用88个基线变量在2,676名参与者中识别出五个OSA原型。各原型在所选人口学、心脏代谢、用药和睡眠变量上存在差异，包括吸烟状况、糖尿病、既往心肌梗死/卒中、抗血小板/降脂治疗、BMI、氧合指标、呼吸暂停低通气指数和ESS（总体p<0.001）。它们在基线EQoL、FRS、MACE发生率和预测的CPAP反应上也存在差异。原型1的ESS、FRS和MACE发生率最高，而原型5的FRS和MACE发生率最低。使用因果生存森林模型评估原型特异性CPAP对心血管风险的影响，预测原型5可从CPAP获益（p<0.05），而原型1、3和4显示无获益或可能有害。【结论】这些发现证明了心血管风险和预测CPAP反应的异质性，可能解释中性试验结果。经过外部验证后，这些原型可指导试验富集和靶向CPAP使用以改善心血管结局。【影响声明】本研究通过识别基线心血管风险和预测CPAP心血管反应不同的多域OSA原型，推进了临床医学，可能支持更精确的治疗选择和未来的心血管结局试验。它通过表明OSA相关心血管风险不能仅由传统严重程度指标捕捉，而是反映睡眠、心脏代谢、人口学和临床特征之间的相互作用，增加了疾病知识基础。这些发现为生物学（biological）的机制性和前瞻性研究提供了框架。

title: Machine Learning Based Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease using Full Blood Count from a Ghanaian Hospital Population with an Integrated Web Application
zh_title: 加纳医院用全血细胞计数机器学习检测 CKD
summary: medRxiv 预印本：基于加纳 155 例患者数据，比较 11 种算法与多种重采样策略，评估全血细胞计数检测慢性肾病。
key_points: 单中心 155 例，其中 CKD 43 例（27.7%）
SMOTE 置于划分前时随机森林准确率 83.9%
结果显示重采样位置明显影响报告性能
reason: 单中心 155 例小样本预印本，仅内部交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is usually silent until advanced, and the tests confirming it are frequently unaffordable in sub-Saharan Africa, whereas the full blood count (FBC) is inexpensive and widely performed. We assessed whether machine learning applied to the FBC can detect CKD, and how far its reported performance depends on where synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) is applied. Records of 155 patients at the Ho Technical University Hospital, Ghana, 43 (27.7%) with CKD, yielded ten features: age, cardiovascular disease and eight raw FBC parameters. Eleven algorithms, six resampling strategies and thirteen ensembles were compared under repeated stratified cross-validation. With SMOTE applied before the train-test split, the protocol under which the deployed models were fitted, Random Forest and Extra Trees both reached an accuracy of 83.9%, with sensitivities of 0.893 and 0.857 and areas under the curve (AUC) of 0.925 and 0.939; repeated cross-validation gave an accuracy of 0.809 {+/-} 0.051 and an AUC of 0.897. With resampling confined to the training folds, the same features gave a held-out accuracy of 61.5% and an AUC of 0.604 in 39 unseen patients. Age was the only variable separating the groups after correction for multiple testing (median 64 versus 47 years, adjusted p = 0.0026). The models are deployed as NephroScan GH (https://nephroscangh.com), which explains every prediction. The FBC carries a real but moderate signal for CKD, and the 22.4 point gap between the two protocols quantifies how far a single preprocessing decision can move a reported accuracy.
zh_abstract: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）通常在进展前没有症状，而确认该病的检查在撒哈拉以南非洲往往难以负担，相比之下全血细胞计数（FBC）廉价且广泛开展。我们评估了将机器学习应用于 FBC 能否检测 CKD，以及其报告的性能在多大程度上取决于合成少数类过采样（SMOTE）应用的位置。加纳 Ho Technical University Hospital 的 155 名患者记录中，43 名（27.7%）患有 CKD，提取了十个特征：年龄、心血管疾病和八项原始 FBC 参数。在重复分层交叉验证下比较了 11 种算法、6 种重采样策略和 13 种集成模型。在训练-测试划分之前应用 SMOTE（即部署模型拟合时所采用的方案）时，随机森林和极端随机树均达到 83.9% 的准确率，灵敏度分别为 0.893 和 0.857，曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 0.925 和 0.939；重复交叉验证给出的准确率为 0.809 {+/-} 0.051，AUC 为 0.897。当重采样仅限训练折内时，相同特征在 39 名未见患者中给出的留出准确率为 61.5%，AUC 为 0.604。经过多重检验校正后，年龄是唯一区分两组的变量（中位数 64 岁对 47 岁，校正 p = 0.0026）。这些模型部署为 NephroScan GH（https://nephroscangh.com），可解释每一次预测。FBC 对 CKD 具有真实但中等的信号，而两种方案之间 22.4 个百分点的差距量化了单个预处理决策能使报告准确率移动多远。

summary: 埃及亚历山大大学注册观察性研究，拟对 200 名护理高年级学生构建并检验 2 型糖尿病风险 AI 模型。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Alexandria University; conditions: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 200; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will develop and test an artificial intelligence (AI) model that estimates the risk of type 2 diabetes among senior (third- and fourth-year) nursing students at the Faculty of Nursing, Alexandria University, Egypt. Type 2 diabetes is common in Egypt, and many cases are not diagnosed. Daily habits such as diet, physical activity, and body weight play a major role in who develops it. Nursing students will become health care providers who teach patients about healthy living, so it is important to find those who may be at risk early. About 200 students will take part. Each student will complete a questionnaire about personal information and the Health-Promoting Lifestyle Profile II, which measures health habits such as nutrition, physical activity, stress management, and health responsibility. The researcher will measure height, weight, waist size, and blood pressure. Each student's diabetes risk will be scored using the Arabic version of the Australian Type 2 Diabetes Risk Assessment Tool (AUSDRISK), which classifies risk as low, moderate, or high. These data will be used to build a machine learning model that predicts each student's diabetes risk level from lifestyle and body measurement factors, and shows which factors influenced the prediction most. Students will then try the model and rate how useful and easy to use it is. No treatment or intervention will be given. The study aims to support early identification of students at risk and to provide a model that nursing education programs and community health nurses could use in preventive health efforts.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：亚历山大大学；疾病：2型糖尿病；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：200；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 本研究将开发并测试一个人工智能（AI）模型，用于估计埃及亚历山大大学护理学院高年级（三年级和四年级）护理学生中2型糖尿病的风险。2型糖尿病在埃及很常见，且许多病例未被诊断。饮食、身体活动和体重等日常习惯在谁会发生该病方面起主要作用。护理学生将成为向患者传授健康生活知识的医疗保健提供者，因此早期发现可能处于风险中的学生很重要。约200名学生将参与。每名学生将完成一份关于个人信息的问卷以及健康促进生活方式量表 II（Health-Promoting Lifestyle Profile II），该量表测量营养、身体活动、压力管理和健康责任等健康习惯。研究者将测量身高、体重、腰围和血压。每名学生的糖尿病风险将使用澳大利亚2型糖尿病风险评估工具（AUSDRISK）阿拉伯语版本进行评分，该工具将风险分类为低、中或高。这些数据将用于构建一个机器学习模型，该模型根据生活方式和身体测量因素预测每名学生的糖尿病风险水平，并显示哪些因素对预测影响最大。随后学生将试用该模型，并评价其有用性和易用性。不给予任何治疗或干预。本研究旨在支持早期识别处于风险中的学生，并提供一个护理教育项目和社区健康护士可用于预防性健康工作的模型。
